title: Physical
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose what someone can read at the distance of use. A commuter across the tracks and a person holding a card encounter the same identity at different scales.
strategic_value: Halfkey can connect a public encounter with a spending limit to an object someone carries home. The weekly figure and split mark give the two encounters a common visual reference.
demonstration: Two large photographs place posters in London and New York. A lower row applies the mark to a tote, the two sides of a business card and a sticker sheet.
practical_value: A designer can compare the amount of information that fits a distant poster with the contact details or small marks that work on objects held in the hand.
